reason: The hypothesis directly applies a well-established method (SPS) to a well-known problem (densifying single-phase ZrB2) and predicts the standard outcomes (higher density, fewer pores, better strength) that are already reported in the literature for ZrB2 and similar ceramics. The mechanism (enhanced diffusion, suppressed grain growth) is taken word-for-word from multiple passages, and the proposed test is a generic comparative study. The only minor novelty is the specific application to liquid plating bath resistance, but this is a trivial extension of the improved density and is not justified by any new mechanism or evidence.
